summary: Wrote the homily for an adult parish assembly on Sunday 8 November 2026 (sections/homily/10-homily.tex, about 1,400 spoken words, an estimated 10.8-11.7 minutes at 120-130 words a minute, never delivered or timed) and its terminal note with References (sections/homily/90-note.tex); declared [document.homily] in publication.toml, added one contribution line to generation-metadata.tex, appended a derive-homily entry to research/production-review.md, and generated homily.tex with tools/tpt document-types refresh. The speech follows the first interpretation: the householder's reason (Mt 13:29), read with Jerome on the likeness of wheat and darnel, Augustine's 'ye are such as may be deceived', and the room for change Jerome and Chrysostom find in ne forte; the servants' work in Col 3:13, Rabanus and Jerome on Jer 29:7; the would-be weeders as the sinners who cry from the depths (Ps 129, Secret); the Collect and Gradual with Aquinas; one response, forgiving before Communion, from Mk 11:25 as Bede reads it; and the harvest with the Postcommunion. The coercion question and Aquinas's Summa are left to the studies, and the Lord's gloss on the good seed (Mt 13:38) is kept. Content preflight, the proper-study content check, the component checks (content, and artifacts on a 4-page author proof) and the document-type and schema checks all pass.
